article.paragraph1: During the first trimester of pregnancy, a woman's diet does not differ significantly from her usual diet, although her food preferences may change. However, it is already important to follow the principles of healthy eating to reduce the risk of morning sickness and lay the foundation for the baby's proper development.
article.paragraph2: Try to include green salads with vegetable oil and sea fish in your daily menu. It is important to start taking folic acid, iodine, and vitamin E supplements and continue them throughout pregnancy. Due to the increased workload on the liver and kidneys, it is advisable to significantly limit spicy foods and seasonings such as pepper, mustard, and vinegar at the beginning of pregnancy. To reduce the load on the liver, replace fried and fatty foods with boiled and stewed dishes, and limit butter, high-fat sour cream, cream, and vegetable oil. Choose low-fat cottage cheese. Along with vegetables and fruits, eat whole-grain bread because it contains fiber and B vitamins.
article.quote: During the first trimester of pregnancy, a woman's diet does not differ significantly from her usual diet, although her food preferences may change. However, it is already important to follow the principles of healthy eating to reduce the risk of morning sickness and lay the foundation for the baby's proper development.
article.extraParagraph: During pregnancy, the body needs enough iron to prevent anemia in both the mother and baby and to build up iron stores for breastfeeding. For this reason, include buckwheat and nuts in your diet regularly.

moscow.title: Payment options in Moscow
moscow.text1: 1. Pay the courier in cash upon delivery;
moscow.text2: 2. Pay the courier by Visa/MasterCard/MIR bank cards without commission;
moscow.text3: 3. Payment by invoice for individuals and legal entities to the organization's bank account. The order will be delivered the day after the funds are credited to our organization's account.

regions.title: Payment options for Russian regions
regions.text1: 1. Pay online through the website using Visa/MasterCard/MIR bank cards without commission;
regions.text2: 2. Pay by invoice for individuals and legal entities to the organization's bank account;
regions.text3: 3. Orders shipped to Russian regions are sent only after 100% prepayment;
regions.text4: 4. Delivery between terminals is paid upon receiving the item at the transport company's terminal (except cities with free delivery).

card.title: Paying by bank card on the website
card.text1: Payment by bank card is made directly on the website online. When placing an order, select the payment method «Pay by bank card». Payment is made on the website immediately after placing the order.
card.text2: After confirming the order contents, your personal information and delivery address, a page will open where you will be asked to enter the payer's bank card details:
card.text3: After entering the card details, carefully check all fields and click the «Pay» button.
card.text4: The transaction is processed through the authorization server of the bank's processing center using MIR, VISA and MasterCard payment cards (Russia and CIS).

bankTransfer.title: Bank transfer
bankTransfer.text1: Payment for the order is made by bank payment order to the store's settlement account.
bankTransfer.text2: When placing an order, select «Bank transfer» as the payment method. Our operator will contact you and issue an invoice. Payment can be made at any bank branch or Russian Post office.
bankTransfer.text3: Please note that banks may charge a commission (usually 1.5–2%) for processing the payment.

moscow.title: Delivery in Moscow
moscow.text1: We deliver orders in Moscow from Monday to Saturday, from 9:00 to 19:00.
moscow.text2: Orders placed before 14:00 will be delivered the next day (except Sunday).
moscow.text3: The courier will call you on the delivery day 40–60 minutes before arriving at the address. Please provide the details of the actual order recipient.
moscow.text4: Orders that require delivery by a transport company will be delivered to the transport company's terminal within 1–2 days after payment is received.

regions.title: We ship goods to any city in Russia!
regions.text1: 1. Shipment is made only after 100% prepayment
regions.text2: 2. Delivery to the transport company's terminal in Moscow and Makhachkala and preparation of shipping documents are FREE
regions.text3: 3. Delivery of goods with paid shipping is charged according to the transport company's rates
regions.text4: 4. Goods are shipped from the terminal in Moscow or Makhachkala to the terminal in the destination city
regions.text5: 5. Goods are delivered in branded packaging, but upon request and at the customer's expense, we can order additional protective crating
regions.attentionText: Due to changes in federal laws, a new mandatory procedure has been introduced for accepting and handing over cargo for forwarding/transportation and verifying customer and cargo information. Transport companies require the recipient's full passport details, including:
regions.text6: Since September 1, 2016, transport companies have not accepted cargo for transportation without these details.
regions.text7: 6. Furniture, plastic and glass products without rigid packaging, and electronic devices require protective crating. The crating is paid by the recipient at the transport company's terminal upon receipt. The cost depends on the destination city and cargo dimensions and is calculated by the transport company.
regions.text8: 7. After the funds are received in the account, the goods are shipped to the transport company within 1–3 business days.
regions.text9: After shipment, we will send you all receipt numbers, as well as the address and phone number of the transport company where you will receive the cargo.
